cohort: Pregnant women attending the antenatal clinic at Bharti Hospital and Research Centre, Pune.
finding: The incidence of preeclampsia was 4.4%, and methyldopa with nifedipine was effective in controlling blood pressure in preeclamptic patients.
gest_age: 31-36 weeks (in the majority of participants with preeclampsia)
birth_weight: Low birth weight (52.3% of babies born to participants with preeclampsia)
